name: roman_numeral
description: Convert small Arabic integers to Roman numerals; matched control copies Arabic number.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
def roman(n):
 out=''
 for v,s in [(10,'X'),(9,'IX'),(5,'V'),(4,'IV'),(1,'I')]:
  while n>=v: out+=s;n-=v
 return out
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 n=i%20+1; tag=random.choice(['Conversion exercise','Numeral quiz','Number exercise','Notation quiz','Practice'])
 items.append({'prompt':f'{tag}: write the Roman numeral.\n1 -> I\n5 -> V\n{n} ->','answer':' '+roman(n)})
 control.append({'prompt':f'{tag}: copy the Arabic numeral.\n1 -> 1\n5 -> 5\n{n} ->','answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
